meta.name: Create studio product videos from 3 photos with OpenAI, fal.ai and YouTube

name: Create product studio videos from photos with OpenAI, fal.ai and YouTube

parameters.content:
## product visual factory with ai images and video

### How it works

This workflow turns three submitted product photos into a complete visual marketing asset pipeline. It validates the uploads, archives originals, uses AI to describe the product and craft an ad-image prompt, generates a studio-style product image through fal.ai, crops it into vertical frames, creates motion clips, stitches them into a final video, and publishes it to YouTube through Blotato. It also logs key URLs/results to Google Sheets and sends Telegram notifications for missing uploads, generation failures, and successful completion.

### Setup steps

- Configure the form trigger with the required product photo upload fields expected by the workflow, matching the binary names used in the rename step.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for the product photo description node and the LangChain chat model used to craft the image prompt.
- Set up Google Drive credentials and target folders for archiving original uploads and publishing generated crop images.
- Set up Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheets/tabs used for crop URL logging and final run logging.
- Add valid fal.ai API authentication to the HTTP Request nodes before activation. The existing StudioAPI Test credential is only a placeholder header and is not treated as fal.ai authentication.
- Configure Telegram bot credentials and chat IDs for missing-upload, failure, and success alerts.
- Configure Blotato credentials and the connected YouTube account/channel used for upload and publishing.

### Customization

You can customize the form fields, image prompt instructions, fal.ai model endpoints and parameters, crop strategy, video motion prompts, Google Drive/Sheets destinations, and the final YouTube title/description or posting settings.

## Receive and validate uploads

Starts the workflow from the product photo intake form and checks that all required image uploads are present before continuing.

## Report missing uploads

Builds an error response when required images are missing and sends a Telegram alert so the failed intake can be addressed.

## Prepare uploaded photos

Renames the incoming binary uploads into standard image fields and separates the three product photos for downstream processing.

## Describe and archive originals

Uses OpenAI to describe the product photos while also saving the original uploads to Google Drive, then pairs the archive results with the generated descriptions and combines them into a unified image story.

## Craft image prompt

Runs the LangChain agent that turns combined product-photo context into a structured ad-image prompt, supported by the OpenAI chat model and structured output parser placed beside it on the canvas.

## Request studio render

Submits the crafted prompt to the fal.ai image-generation endpoint and checks whether a render job or response is available.

## Handle render failure

Sends a Telegram failure alert when image generation does not validate successfully, then ends the failed run cleanly.

## Fetch rendered image

Waits for the asynchronous render to finish, retrieves the generated image from the response URL, and reads its dimensions for crop calculations.

## Publish top crop

Creates the top-third crop of the rendered image, uploads it to Google Drive, and logs the resulting URL to Google Sheets.

## Publish middle crop

Creates the middle-third crop, publishes it to Google Drive, and logs its URL for both downstream motion-clip pairings.

## Publish bottom crop

Creates the bottom-third crop of the rendered image, uploads it to Google Drive, and logs the crop URL to Google Sheets.

## Generate first motion clip

Pairs the top and middle crop frames, then sends them to the fal.ai first-last-frame video endpoint to create the first motion segment.

## Generate second motion clip

Pairs the middle and bottom crop frames, then creates the second motion segment with the same video-generation service.

## Stitch generated clips

Combines the two motion-generation results, builds the merge payload, and calls the fal.ai FFmpeg merge endpoint to stitch the clips into one video.

## Upload and publish video

Waits for the stitch operation, uploads the final video to Blotato, and publishes it to YouTube.

## Log and notify success

Records the completed run in Google Sheets and sends a Telegram success notification after the YouTube publish step completes.

options.systemMessage:
=You output a prompt that is a variation of the prompt below. Follow this prompt exactly but just change:

-the hand positioning based on what makes sense for the product
-how the product is worn and where it is placed

everything else stays the same

***

Show a high fashion studio photoshoot image of this reference character as a photorealistic model wearing the featured apparel and product, captured as a full body shot. The model looks slightly past the camera with a bored expression and raised eyebrows. One hand is lifted, with two fingers interacting with or touching the featured product in a natural, stylish way.

The setting is a clean studio environment with a solid color background that matches the primary color of the character. The featured product is intentionally prominent.

The image is shot from a low angle, looking up at the subject to emphasize presence and dominance.

The photo is captured on Fuji Velvia film using a 55mm prime lens with hard flash lighting. Light is concentrated on the subject and softly fades toward the edges of the frame. The image is intentionally overexposed, with visible film grain and heavy oversaturation. Skin appears shiny, almost oily, and the featured product shows harsh white reflections that highlight its surface and form.
